args.title: Bellwether: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
Three-bullet combined summary of the Bellwether Office newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

- Newsletter (Bellwether Office): This week's topic is retail returns logistics; the full article is on the blog, with a free, no-password companion piece available via email registration (registered with owen.brandt@northwind.example).
- Article: Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.

Sources:
- https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns
- https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion
